positions.title: Engineering Manager, AR Platform
positions.description:
- Work closely cross-functionally with customers and product to prioritize and help plan work across three main areas: developer platform and tools (Unity/C# API),  C++ platform and infrastructure, as well as internal build infrastructure and release management
- Coach and mentor seven engineers ranging from junior to senior, helping to develop their career plans with goals, providing constructive feedback, and giving performance reviews
- Developed a comprehensive QA plan for platform releases and worked closely with QA team to implement
- Actively building up current team by working with leadership to identify, interview, and hire several individuals

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, AR Platform
positions.description:
- Designed and led effort to create cross platform C# API that supports device-native AR SDKs as well as an internal C++ library.
- Worked with internal developers on-boarding to the platform to ensure their needs were met: developing feature requests, providing support, as well as implementing bug fixes
- Helped with integration of AR features into Pokémon GO as well as Harry Potter: Wizards Unite.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed Objective-C and Swift APIs to support a cross-platform C++ SLAM library

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed multiple science exhibits for a STEM outreach program (e.g. a “Smart Jacket” and a “Smart Dollhouse”)
- Assisted summer camp sessions teaching high school students to program in Java
- Performed high-powered RF amplifier testing and assembly

positions.title: Product Engineer II
positions.description: Coordinate, execute and help define design and process engineering changes on production databases. This includes layout edits and verification with LVS and DRC; schematic edits and verification with simulation and parasitic extraction tools; documenting database revisions and taping out revised masks. Additional responsibilities include supporting Product Engineering on database related debug tools, and assisting Product Engineering groups with overall IC debug.

positions.title: A/V Technician
positions.description: Set up and operated audio and visual equipment for various events on USC campus ranging from in-class video instruction to large-scale Presidential events. Have experience with both analog and digital mixing boards, advanced sound-busing techniques, microphone placement, and loudspeaker setup.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Building and managing of a human-sized mascot robot for the Discovery Bus, an outreach program for the STAR Science Center. Also build various other exhibit for Science Center.

positions.title: A/V Technician
positions.description: Involved in maintaining and setting up various types of audio and visual equipment for customers. Set-up and operate audio and visual equipment for various events requiring speakers, microphones, projectors, etc.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Researched and developed scientific exhibits for a Center of Science to be built within the next few years.

projects.title: DC-DC Buck Voltage Converter Design
projects.description: Worked on a team that designed, soldered and presented a functional DC-DC buck voltage converter on a printed circuit board, utilizing a MAX1627 controller and a board layout that would introduce limited switching noise. This project was part EE348L (Electronic Circuits).

projects.title: Veritune
projects.description: An implementation of a radix-2 decimation-in-time FFT targeted to the Spartan 3E FPGA, and a phase vocoder modeled in MATLAB
